'''Alaric''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]]. On [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], he instructed several Imperials on the history of the [[Dark Temple]].
